assertions.assertion: The member presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
was evaluated via Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229)
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmias and to assess for rhythm disturbances contributing to the patient's clinical presentation
This precertification was denied under Reason Code CO-197
the payer attributes to the absence of advance approval for this diagnostic procedure
